paragraphs.text: In developing the project, the proponent gathered all the relevant information and considered various technology options before selecting the tools to be used. Through these tools, learners can study the content of Land Grand, which covers landforms, rocks, and minerals, while enjoying an interactive game experience. The main tools used in the development of the application include the Unity Engine, Piskel, Clip Studio Paint, and Visual Studio Code, with C# as the programming language.

paragraphs.text: This section covers the tools used to create the Android application, including both the software and hardware components of the project. The selected components were chosen to meet the requirements of the game application and to ensure good performance, compatibility, and efficiency. The proponent recognizes that Unity offers a strong and flexible development platform that supports two-dimensional game development, real-time rendering, and an extensive library of assets, which makes it well suited for developing an interactive and educational game application such as Land Grand.

paragraphs.text: The Unity Engine was founded in Copenhagen, Denmark, and was designed by David Helgason, Joachim Ante, and Nicholas Francis. It is one of the well-known game engines used to create a wide range of games and applications. The Unity Engine can be used without payment for its core features, and numerous tutorials are available for learning how to use it, which makes it accessible for student developers.

paragraphs.text: The process for using the application is clear and straightforward. The first step is to run the application on an Android device, which requires the learner to download and install the application beforehand. From the Main Menu, the learner can choose Play, Settings, Tutorial, or Exit. After selecting Play, the learner is taken to the Landform Map, which contains four episodes representing the major landforms: Mountains, Hills, Plains, and Plateaus. Only unlocked episodes can be selected, and the remaining episodes become available after the learner completes the previous episode.

paragraphs.text: Before each level begins, a Lesson Screen introduces the selected landform and the rocks or minerals that can be found there using simple explanations. During gameplay, the learner controls an explorer character to move through the landform, collect rocks and minerals, and overcome challenges such as obstacles, traps, pitfalls, and time limits. When a rock or mineral is collected, a pop-up displays its name together with a short description, giving the learner information about the item before continuing.

paragraphs.text: The learner must complete the Easy levels before unlocking the Normal levels, and the Normal levels before unlocking the Hard levels. After completing a level, the Result Screen displays the collected rocks and minerals, the stars earned, and a short review of the lesson. The learner may then replay the level or continue to the next available level.
